description: `useMemo(calculate, deps)` caches the **result** of a calculation between renders and recomputes only when a dependency changes.
Every reactive value (props, state, values derived from them) read inside the calculation. Compared with `Object.is`.
A memoized object or array keeps the same reference, which lets `memo` children and effect dependencies see it as unchanged.
React may discard cached values (e.g. during development edits or for offscreen content). Code must stay correct without the cache.
